# Environment variables

<!-- generated by tools/env_check.py --write-docs from kalmido/core/env.py - do not edit by hand -->

Every variable the server reads, with its default. Set them in `.env` (Docker Compose) or the environment of the
container. Switches accept `1`, `true`, `yes`, `on` (on) and `0`, `false`, `no`, `off` (off), in any case;
an empty value counts as unset. See [SELF-HOSTING.md](SELF-HOSTING.md) for the context of each area.

## Core: data, database, address

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | `(empty)` | PostgreSQL connection (postgresql://user:password@host:5432/db). Required. |
| `KALMIDO_ACX_TTL` | `10` | Seconds the access context of a person (roles, organisations) is cached per process (0 = off). |
| `KALMIDO_ALLOW_DOWNGRADE` | `0` | Switch: start on a database (or restore a backup) that a newer minor version of Kalmido wrote. Only for an emergency; the older version may not understand newer data. |
| `KALMIDO_DB_POOL_MAX` | `(empty)` | Largest number of pooled database connections per process (empty = threads x 3 + 8). |
| `KALMIDO_DB_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT` | `30` | Seconds one database statement of a request may run (0 = no limit). |
| `KALMIDO_DB_WAIT` | `60` | Seconds the start waits for the database to answer. |
| `KALMIDO_INSTANCE_MODE` | `(empty)` | Older switch of the instance mode (shared / workspaces); since 2.46 only read for the row-level security check. |
| `KALMIDO_IOS_SHORTCUT_URL` | `(empty)` | Link to an iOS shortcut shown in Settings > Integrations (empty = hidden). |
| `KALMIDO_MIGRATE_CLI` | `(empty)` | Internal: set by `python app.py migrate-sqlite` for the move from SQLite. |
| `KALMIDO_ONBOARDING` | `1` | Switch: new accounts get a sample list and the welcome tour. |
| `KALMIDO_ORG_NAME` | `(empty)` | Name of the first organisation created on a new server. |
| `KALMIDO_POOL_MAX` | `(empty)` | Older name of KALMIDO_DB_POOL_MAX (used when that one is not set). |
| `KALMIDO_REPLICAS` | `1` | Number of web processes behind one database (only for the connection check at start). |
| `KALMIDO_ROLE` | `all` | What this process runs: all (web + background work), web (requests only) or worker (background work only). |
| `KALMIDO_SEARCH_INDEX` | `0` | Switch: allow search engines to index this server (public links and forms stay noindex). |
| `KALMIDO_SLOW_REQUEST_MS` | `500` | Requests slower than this many milliseconds get a log line with route, duration and statement count (0 = off). |
| `KALMIDO_THREADS` | `16` | Web server threads per process (2-256). |
| `KALMIDO_UPDATE_CHECK` | `1` | Switch: admins see when a newer release exists (one request a few times a day, never updates anything). |
| `KALMIDO_UPDATE_URL` | `https://api.github.com/repos/Gegenschuss/kalmido/releases/latest` | Address the update check asks for the latest release. |
| `PATH` | `(empty)` | Search path for the helper programs (pg_dump, tesseract); passed on to them unchanged. |
| `PORT` | `3040` | Port the web server listens on inside the container. |
| `PUBLIC_URL` | `http://localhost:3040` | The address people use to open Kalmido (https://tasks.example.com). Used for links in notifications and mails, passkeys and the origin check; set it on every server. |
| `TASKS_ATTACHMENTS` | `<data dir>/attachments` | Folder of the uploaded files. |
| `TASKS_DB` | `/data/tasks.db` | Names the data directory (its folder holds attachments, office files, backups and the marker file) and an old SQLite file from before 2.37 that is moved to PostgreSQL on the first start. |
| `TASKS_EXPORT_DIR` | `<data dir>/exports` | Folder of the organisation exports while they are offered for download. |
| `TASKS_MAX_FILE_MB` | `50` | Largest upload in MB. |
| `TASKS_OFFICE_DIR` | `<data dir>/office` | Folder of the office files (logos, documents); part of the backups. |
| `TASKS_TEXT_CACHE` | `<data dir>/textcache` | Folder of the extracted text of attachments (search, previews). |
| `TZ` | `Europe/Berlin` | Time zone of the server (due dates, daily jobs, reminders). |

## Login, accounts and proxy

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_BOOTSTRAP_NAME` | `(empty)` | Display name of that admin (empty = the user name). |
| `AUTH_BOOTSTRAP_PROXY_LOGIN` | `(empty)` | Proxy login name linked to that admin. |
| `AUTH_BOOTSTRAP_USER` | `admin` | User name of the admin created when an old single-user database is taken over. |
| `AUTH_PROXY_HEADER` | `(empty)` | Header of a trusted proxy that carries the user name (single sign-on), e.g. Remote-User. |
| `AUTH_PROXY_PORT` | `(empty)` | Port that only accepts proxy-header logins (the normal port then ignores the header). |
| `AUTH_SESSION_DAYS` | `30` | Days a login stays valid. |
| `AUTH_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | `(empty)` | Addresses / networks allowed to send AUTH_PROXY_HEADER. |
| `KALMIDO_DISC_PER_IP` | `60` | Account searches and checks per client address in 15 minutes. |
| `KALMIDO_IP_WARN_ACCOUNTS` | `3` | Accounts signing in from one private address before the log warns (missing proxy setup). |
| `KALMIDO_OIDC_ADMIN_DOMAINS` | `(empty)` | Verified e-mail domains whose people become admins. |
| `KALMIDO_OIDC_ADMIN_GROUP` | `(empty)` | Group whose members become admins. |
| `KALMIDO_OIDC_ALLOW_HOSTS` | `(empty)` | Internal hosts an OpenID Connect provider may live on. |
| `KALMIDO_OIDC_BUTTON_LABEL` | `(empty)` | Text of the sign-in button. |
| `KALMIDO_OIDC_CLIENT_ID` | `(empty)` | OpenID Connect client id. |
| `KALMIDO_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` | `(empty)` | OpenID Connect client secret. |
| `KALMIDO_OIDC_GROUPS_CLAIM` | `(empty)` | Claim that holds the groups. |
| `KALMIDO_OIDC_ISSUER` | `(empty)` | OpenID Connect issuer URL (locks the setting in the app). |
| `KALMIDO_OIDC_REQUIRED_GROUP` | `(empty)` | Group a person must be in to sign in. |
| `KALMIDO_OIDC_SCOPES` | `(empty)` | OpenID Connect scopes. |
| `KALMIDO_OIDC_USERNAME_CLAIM` | `(empty)` | Claim that holds the user name. |
| `KALMIDO_PORTAL_LOGIN_SPACE` | `200` | Sign-in mails of the client portal per workspace and hour. |
| `KALMIDO_SETUP_CODE` | `(empty)` | One-time code of the first setup: empty = a random code in the log, a fixed value, or off (tests only). |
| `KALMIDO_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | `127.0.0.1,::1` | Reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For / -Proto headers are believed. |
| `KALMIDO_TRUSTED_PROXY_COUNT` | `1` | Number of trusted proxies in a row in front of the server (1-5). |
| `KALMIDO_WEBAUTHN_ORIGINS` | `(empty)` | Additional origins allowed for passkeys, comma-separated. A `localhost` page counts on its own only when `PUBLIC_URL` is a localhost address (2.190.0). |
| `KALMIDO_WEBAUTHN_RP_ID` | `(empty)` | Passkey domain (empty = the host of PUBLIC_URL). |
| `TASKS_DROP_TOKEN` | `(empty)` | Upload token of the first admin when an old single-user database is taken over. |

## Server key, encryption and limits

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `KALMIDO_LOG_FULL_IP` | `1` | Switch: failed sign-ins in the server log keep the full address (fail2ban bans by it); 0 shortens it like the alerts (IPv4 /24, IPv6 /48). |
| `KALMIDO_NO_SECRET_KEY` | `0` | Switch: let a NEW server start without a server key (data then stays unencrypted). Tests and demos only. |
| `KALMIDO_ORGCRYPT_DELAY` | `(empty)` | Seconds before the background encryption pass starts after a start (default: 300). |
| `KALMIDO_ORGCRYPT_PAUSE` | `0.2` | Seconds between two portions of the background encryption pass. |
| `KALMIDO_ORGCRYPT_ROT_SETTLE` | `5` | Seconds the key rotation waits after the switch to the new key. |
| `KALMIDO_PUBLIC_BURST` | `300` | Views of one public link in a short time that raise a security alert. |
| `KALMIDO_PUBLIC_RATE` | `60` | Page views of public links per client address and minute. |
| `KALMIDO_SECRET_FILE` | `(empty)` | File that holds the server key; created once when missing. Must not lie inside the data or backup folder. In the image: /secret/kalmido.key when /secret is a mounted volume. |
| `KALMIDO_SECRET_KEY` | `(empty)` | The server key (32 bytes, base64). Encrypts organisation data and stored tokens; wins over KALMIDO_SECRET_FILE. Keep a copy apart from the backups. |
| `KALMIDO_SUPPORTER_EXTRA_PUBKEYS` | `(empty)` | Additional public keys accepted for supporter licences. |
| `KALMIDO_TENANT_CHECK` | `(empty)` | Daily check of the organisation boundaries: empty = daily, always = every watchdog tick, 0 / off = never. |
| `KALMIDO_TENANT_CHECK_HOUR` | `3` | Local hour from which the daily boundary check runs. |

| `NTFY_INBOX_USER` | `(empty)` | Account that receives the shared items (empty = the first admin). |

| `NTFY_TOPIC` | `(empty)` | ntfy topic of the first admin (later accounts get their own). |
| `NTFY_URL` | `https://ntfy.sh` | ntfy server for push notifications. |
| `TASKS_NEWS_DAYS` | `90` | Days the News entries are kept. |
| `TASKS_NEWS_MAX` | `500` | News entries kept per person at most. |
| `TASKS_PUSH_GAP` | `60` | Least seconds between two comment notifications of one task. |

| `KALMIDO_EMBED_CLEAN` | `60` | Seconds between two clean-ups of the embeddings. |
| `KALMIDO_EMBED_DOWN` | `60` | Seconds of pause after the embedding service failed. |
| `KALMIDO_EMBED_IDLE` | `15` | Seconds between two looks of the embedding pass when nothing waits. |
| `KALMIDO_EMBED_URL` | `(empty)` | Address of the optional embedding service (related tasks, meaning search; empty = off). |
| `KALMIDO_RELATED_DUP` | `0.96` | Similarity from which two tasks count as probable duplicates. |
| `KALMIDO_RELATED_MIN` | `0.90` | Lowest similarity of a related task. |
| `KALMIDO_RELATED_MIX` | `nsum` | Order of the related tasks (how meaning and title similarity are mixed). |
| `KALMIDO_RELATED_NORM` | `0.84` | Normalisation point of the similarity for that order. |
| `KALMIDO_RELATED_SEARCH` | `0.82` | Lowest similarity of a meaning search hit. |
| `KALMIDO_STARTER_BASE` | `https://github.com/Gegenschuss/kalmido/raw/v{version}/mcp/` | Download address of the agent starter files ({version} is replaced). |
| `KALMIDO_TIDY_QUIET_S` | `120` | Seconds a project must be quiet before its tidy agent is asked. |
| `KALMIDO_USAGE_DAYS` | `400` | Days the agent usage records are kept. |

## Background work and timing

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `KALMIDO_ACCOUNT_IMPORT_PARALLEL` | `2` | At most this many account checks / imports run at once on the whole server (2.148.1). |
| `KALMIDO_LOOP_LOCKS` | `1` | Each background loop runs in one process of the instance; 0 = every process runs its loops. |
| `KALMIDO_STALE_HOUR` | `09:00` | Local time from which the daily event about stale tasks goes out. |
| `KALMIDO_WORKER_HEARTBEAT` | `30` | Seconds between two heartbeats of a background loop. |
| `TASKS_WATCHDOG` | `1` | Switch: the background work of this process (reminders, backups, calendars, encryption pass). Helper processes set 0. |
| `TASKS_WATCHDOG_INTERVAL` | `30` | Seconds between two watchdog rounds (reminders, schedules). |

## Hosting, retention and quotas

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `KALMIDO_HOSTED` | `0` | Switch: a server run as a service for others; integrations may only reach public HTTPS addresses. |
| `KALMIDO_OPERATOR_TOKEN_FILE` | `(empty)` | File with the token of the hosting operator interface (empty = off). |
| `KALMIDO_PURGE_TRASH` | `(empty)` | Switch for the trash only; empty = KALMIDO_RETENTION_PURGE. |
| `KALMIDO_RETENTION_PURGE` | `0` | Switch: really delete what is past its retention time (off = only count and report). |
| `KALMIDO_STORAGE_QUOTA_MB` | `(empty)` | Storage per person in MB (empty / 0 = unlimited; admins can set it in the app). |
| `KALMIDO_SUPPORT_EMAIL` | `(empty)` | Support address shown when the storage is full. |
| `KALMIDO_SUPPORT_URL` | `(empty)` | Support page shown in Settings > Help. |
| `KALMIDO_TRASH_DAYS` | `30` | Days items stay in the trash. |

## Tests and development (not for production)

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `KALMIDO_PEPPOL_STORECOVE_URL` | `(empty)` | Tests: the address of a stand-in for the Storecove Peppol API (empty = the real one, 2.154.0). |
| `KALMIDO_SHEET_CELLS_MAX` | `1000000` | Tests: stored cells over all sheets of one table (2.148.1). |
| `KALMIDO_SHEET_RANGE_BUDGET` | `15000000` | Tests: range cells one evaluation of a table may read (2.148.1). |
| `KALMIDO_TEST` | `0` | Switch: marks a test container (set by tests/start.sh); only then KALMIDO_TEST_NOW and KALMIDO_TEST_RATE_WINDOW_S work. Never on a real server. |
| `KALMIDO_TEST_MODE` | `0` | Test containers only: allows the test switches of the organisation key tool (1); left alone in a server's .env it is ignored. |
| `KALMIDO_TEST_NOW` | `(empty)` | Test containers only (with KALMIDO_TEST=1): the server clock starts at this ISO time and runs on from there. |
| `KALMIDO_TEST_NOW_AT` | `(empty)` | Test containers only: the real Unix second KALMIDO_TEST_NOW belongs to (app and worker share one shifted clock). |
| `KALMIDO_TEST_ROT_ABORT` | `(empty)` | Tests: stop the key rotation right after the switch (1). |
